title: Asian Immigrants, School Quality, and the US Housing Market
Extreme temperatures, adaptation capacity, and household retail consumption
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: While the large cost of extreme temperatures on production is well documented, relatively little is known about its impact on consumption despite its importance for welfare. Using high-frequency micro-shopping data from US households, we report three findings. First, deviating from mild temperatures negatively affects the number of store visits, but the impact on overall purchases is moderated by greater purchases per store visit, especially for extremely cold days. Second, households actively manage inventory over time, which nullifies the impact of extreme cold. However, extreme heat appears to have a persistent negative impact on consumption. Third, passenger cars substantially moderate the negative impact of extreme temperatures on consumption while rideshare services or public transit do not produce comparable moderating effects. These findings suggest that the economic cost of extreme temperatures on consumption is likely to be concentrated on disadvantaged households.
abstract_zh: 尽管极端温度对生产造成的巨大成本已有充分记录，但其对消费的影响（尽管对福利至关重要）却鲜为人知。利用美国家庭高频的微观购物数据，我们报告了三项发现。第一，偏离温和气温的情况会减少商店光顾次数，但每次光顾的购买量增加在一定程度上缓和了对总购买量的影响，极寒日尤其如此。第二，家庭会随时间主动管理库存，这抵消了极寒的影响。然而，极端高温似乎对消费产生了持续性的负面影响。第三，私家车在很大程度上缓和了极端温度对消费的负面影响，而网约车或公共交通则未产生类似的缓和效果。这些发现表明，极端温度对消费造成的经济成本很可能集中于弱势家庭。

title: JUE Insight: Political geography and the spatial allocation of economic activity: Evidence from China's anti-corruption campaign

Understanding Housing Market Responses to Stringent Energy Codes
abstract: Increased energy efficiency in buildings is essential to reducing carbon emissions and addressing climate change. How do the more energy efficient building codes that are needed affect housing prices and housing production? To reduce carbon emissions by 50% by 2030 and achieve net-zero emissions by 2050, Massachusetts enacted the Green Communities Act of 2008, which requires the adoption of a Stretch Energy Code appendix in order to be designated a "Green Community" and be eligible for certain state funding. This appendix to the base building code adds energy-efficiency mandates, including a requirement that all new residential construction meet increasingly ambitious Home Energy Rating System (HERS) Index scores. In addition to their obvious environmental benefits, more stringent energy-efficiency requirements may lead to increased construction costs and have effects housing production and affordability. Using the staggered municipal adoption of the Stretch Energy Code to tease out causal relationships, we analyze the effects of the Stretch Energy Code on housing quantity and price across municipalities in Massachusetts. The results indicate that more energy-efficient properties command a sales price premium of 3.1% to 3.4%, and that the Stretch Energy Code adoption is associated with a decrease in the quantity of new housing starts (especially for single-family homes). Roughly 60% of the total price increase appears to be attributable to a higher willingness to pay for energy-efficient homes, with the remaining percentage explained by the increase in construction costs coupled with the decrease in housing supply.
abstract_zh: 提高建筑能效对于减少碳排放和应对气候变化至关重要。所需的更高能效建筑标准将如何影响房价和住房供给？为了到2030年将碳排放减少50%，并到2050年实现净零排放，马萨诸塞州于2008年颁布了《绿色社区法》，该法要求采用“拉伸能源规范”附录，以获得“绿色社区”称号并具备获得某些州级资金的资格。该附录作为基础建筑规范的补充，增加了能效强制性要求，包括所有新建住宅须满足日益严格的家庭能源评级系统（HERS）指数标准。除了明显的环境效益之外，更为严格的能效要求还可能导致建造成本上升，并对住房供给和可负担性产生影响。我们利用马萨诸塞州各市交错采纳“拉伸能源规范”的做法来识别因果关系，分析该规范对各市住房数量和价格的影响。结果表明，能效更高的住房享有3.1%至3.4%的销售价格溢价，而“拉伸能源规范”的采纳与新开工住房数量的减少相关（对独栋住宅尤为明显）。房价总涨幅中约60%似乎可归因于人们为能效更高的住房支付意愿的提高，其余部分则由建造成本上升与住房供给减少共同解释。

title: Unequal impacts of rising temperatures on global human sentiment
abstract: Climate change poses growing risks to human well-being, yet research on its emotional impact has primarily focused on developed nations, obscuring potential global inequalities in psychological vulnerability. Here, we analyze over 1.2 billion social media posts from 157 countries to reveal how rising temperatures affect human sentiment worldwide and project future impacts under climate scenarios. We find a non-linear relationship where moderate warming can improve sentiment in cooler regions, but temperatures above 35°C negatively impact emotional well-being globally, with effects three times greater in low- and middle-income countries (25.0% decline in sentiment) than in high-income countries (8.1%). Even accounting for climate adaptation through income growth, we project global average sentiment will be 2.3% lower in 2100 than in 2019 due to future warming, indicating lasting psychological costs disproportionately burdening the world's poorest populations. These findings underscore the urgent need for climate policies that integrate emotional impacts and address inequalities in psychological climate vulnerability.
abstract_zh: 气候变化对人类福祉构成日益增长的风险，然而，关于其情绪影响的研究主要集中于发达国家，掩盖了全球心理脆弱性方面可能存在的不平等。在此，我们分析了来自157个国家的超过12亿条社交媒体帖子，以揭示气温上升如何影响全球人类情绪，并在气候情景下预测未来的影响。我们发现一种非线性关系：适度变暖可以改善较寒冷地区的情绪，但超过35°C的气温会对全球情绪健康产生负面影响，且低收入和中等收入国家的影响是高收入国家的三倍（情绪下降25.0%，而高收入国家为8.1%）。即使考虑到通过收入增长实现的气候适应，我们仍预测，由于未来的气候变暖，2100年全球平均情绪水平将比2019年低2.3%，这表明持续存在的心理成本正不成比例地加重于世界上最贫困人口的负担。这些发现强调，迫切需要制定将情绪影响纳入考量、并应对心理气候脆弱性不平等问题的气候政策。

title: Climate Risk and Collateral Misreporting
Entrepreneurship, sustainability, and urban development
Intercity connectivity and urban innovation
Quantifying the impacts of climate shocks in commercial real estate markets
abstract: This study investigates the capitalization of climate shocks in commercial real estate owned and operated by professional investors. We focus on Hurricanes Harvey and Sandy to quantify the price impacts of climate shocks on commercial buildings in Texas and New York. We find clear evidence of a decline in transaction prices in hurricane‐damaged areas after the hurricanes made landfall, compared to unaffected areas. We also observe that the “new news” about climate risk is significantly priced in both states—assets in locations outside the FEMA floodplain (with a lower prior perception of flood risk) that were inundated by the hurricanes experienced larger price discounts, indicating that actual flooding updates investors' perception of flood risk. Moreover, we find that the hurricane discount is more pronounced among buyers with more transaction experience. The transaction price discount also increases with higher climate change beliefs in the local market and among investors. Our findings underline the role of information provision and environmental awareness in the materialization of climate risks' impact on commercial real estate values.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了由专业投资者持有和运营的商业房地产中气候冲击的资本化情况。我们以飓风哈维和桑迪为对象，量化气候冲击对得克萨斯州和纽约州商业建筑价格的影响。与未受影响地区相比，我们发现飓风登陆后，受飓风破坏地区的成交价格明显下降。我们还观察到，关于气候风险的“新信息”在两州均被显著计入价格——位于联邦紧急事务管理局（FEMA）洪泛区之外（此前对洪水风险的认知较低）、但被飓风淹没的资产，经历了更大的价格折扣，这表明实际的洪水会更新投资者对洪水风险的认知。此外，我们发现飓风折扣在交易经验更丰富的买家中更为明显。在当地市场以及投资者中，对气候变化的信念越强，成交价格折扣也越大。我们的发现强调了信息提供和环境意识在气候风险对商业房地产价值产生影响的过程中所起的作用。

title: How the US-China Trade War Accelerated Urban Economic Growth and Environmental Progress in Northern Vietnam
abstract: The Trump Administration's tariffs created a wedge between mutually beneficial trades between China's producers and U.S. consumers. Moving production to nearby Vietnam allows firms to jump the tariff wall. Within Vietnam, cities closer to China with respect to distance and industrial mix grow faster and attract more FDI. They are increasingly consuming renewable power to fuel their local economy. We study the local air quality gains and the carbon dioxide emissions reductions associated with the growth in regional trade. China’s regional trade increases have important implications for the rise of the system of cities across Asia.
abstract_zh: 特朗普政府的关税在中国生产者与美国消费者之间互利的贸易中制造了一道楔子。将生产转移至邻近的越南，使企业得以跨越关税壁垒。在越南境内，就距离和产业结构而言更接近中国的城市增长更快，吸引了更多外国直接投资（FDI）。这些城市对可再生电力的消费也在日益增长，以支撑其本地经济。我们研究了与区域贸易增长相关的当地空气质量改善和二氧化碳减排。中国区域贸易的增长对亚洲城市体系的兴起具有重要意义。

title: The Challenge of Pivotal Timing: Sustainable Shareholder Proposals in Real Asset Investments
abstract: Institutional investors submit shareholder proposals to improve firms’ environmental and social performance, yet evidence of their effectiveness remains limited. This paper shows that timing matters, as proposals increase sustainable investment only when they align with reinvestment cycles and long-lived assets are due for replacement. SEC filing rules and the unpredictable depreciation of assets create quasi-random timing variation, enabling causal identification. Using novel retrofit data for all U.S. public commercial real estate firms for the period 1990–2022, we find that proposals submitted during reinvestment cycles raise sustainable retrofits by 21.5%; otherwise, there is no effect. These findings are replicated in heavy manufacturing, reinforcing the contention that their efficacy depends on when investors choose to act.
abstract_zh: 机构投资者提交股东提案，以改善企业的环境和社会绩效，但关于其有效性的证据仍然有限。本文表明时机至关重要：只有当提案与再投资周期相吻合、且长寿命资产恰逢需要更换之时，提案才会增加可持续投资。SEC的申报规则以及资产折旧的不可预测性产生了准随机的时间变异，从而使因果识别成为可能。利用1990至2022年间美国所有公开上市商业房地产企业的新颖改造数据，我们发现，在再投资周期内提交的提案使可持续改造增加21.5%；否则则无影响。这些发现在重工业中得到了复现，进一步证实了其效力取决于投资者选择行动的时机。

title: Intraday adaptation to extreme temperatures in outdoor activity
abstract: Linkages between climate and human activity are often calibrated at daily or monthly resolutions, which lacks the granularity to observe intraday adaptation behaviors. Ignoring this adaptation margin could mischaracterize the health consequences of future climate change. Here, we construct an hourly outdoor leisure activity database using billions of cell phone location requests in 10,499 parks in 2017 all over China to investigate the within-day outdoor activity rhythm. We find that hourly temperatures above 30 °C and 35 °C depress outdoor leisure activities by 5% (95% confidence interval, CI 3–7%) and by 13% (95% CI 10–16%) respectively. This activity-depressing effect is larger than previous daily or monthly studies due to intraday activity substitution from noon and afternoon to morning and evening. Intraday adaptation is larger for locations and dates with time flexibility, for individuals more frequently exposed to heat, and for parks situated in urban areas. Such within-day adaptation substantially reduces heat exposure, yet it also delays the active time at night by about half an hour, with potential side effect on sleep quality. Combining empirical estimates with outputs from downscaled climate models, we show that unmitigated climate change will generate sizable activity-depressing and activity-delaying effects in summer when projected on an hourly resolution. Our findings call for more attention in leveraging real-time activity data to understand intraday adaptation behaviors and their associated health consequences in climate change research.
abstract_zh: 气候与人类活动之间的联系通常以日或月为分辨率进行校准，这缺乏观察日内适应行为所需的精细度。忽视这一适应维度，可能会对未来气候变化的健康后果产生错误刻画。在此，我们利用2017年中国境内10,499个公园中数十亿条手机定位请求，构建了逐小时户外休闲活动数据库，以考察日内户外活动节律。我们发现，逐小时气温超过30°C和35°C分别使户外休闲活动减少5%（95%置信区间为3%至7%）和13%（95%置信区间为10%至16%）。由于活动从中午和下午转移到早晨和傍晚，这种抑制效应大于以往的日度或月度研究。在时间安排较为灵活的地点和日期、更频繁暴露于高温的个体以及位于城市地区的公园，日内适应更为明显。这种日内适应大幅减少了热暴露，但也使夜间活动时间推迟了约半小时，可能对睡眠质量产生副作用。将实证估计与降尺度气候模型的输出相结合，我们表明，在不加缓解的气候变化情景下，若以逐小时分辨率进行预测，夏季将产生相当可观的活动抑制和活动延迟效应。我们的发现呼吁，在气候变化研究中应更加重视利用实时活动数据来理解日内适应行为及其相关的健康后果。

title: Quantifying the financial value of building decarbonization technology under uncertainty: Integrating energy modeling and investment analysis
abstract: Property owners are facing increasing pressure from regulators, investors, and tenants to reduce building greenhouse emissions, particularly in large cities. Decarbonizing real estate requires costly investments for property owners, that tend to be recouped with the increase in property cashflows over a multi-decade horizon. The assessment of returns associated with those investments tend to be challenged by ongoing changes in regulatory environments and market conditions that hinders the ability of property owners to forecast the ultimate impact of decarbonizing investments on future energy costs, carbon emissions penalties or rental premiums. Against this background, building developers need a tool to assess the value of decarbonization upgrades under future uncertainties. Such a decision-making tool for building electrification will be critical for new as well as existing buildings. This paper develops an integrated framework that combines energy modelling with investment analysis to support the adoption of decarbonizing technologies under a context of uncertainty. This integrated framework includes projections of costs and benefits associated with the adoption of technology (i.e., changes in rental cashflows, vacancy rates, maintenance and energy costs) under a wide range of potential pathways of the energy markets and regulatory environment, and local real estate market demand for green buildings using Monte Carlo simulations. Additionally, this paper develops the approach to investigate the potential value of flexibility in designing for building electrification (i.e., the ability to fully electrify gas heating systems at a later year). We illustrate the use of this approach in a case study of a new office building in New York City. We evaluate the decision to adopt of a fully electric heating system, against a heating system relying on natural gas that serves as a baseline. We consider 10,000 scenarios changing future greenhouse emission penalties, investments in local electric grid, local real estate market conditions and energy prices. Our simulations indicate that, in approximately 76 percent of scenarios, the most profitable decision for the building owner is to adopt a natural gas-powered heating system. However, adopting a building design that provides a building the flexibility to fully electrify at a later date is more profitable than a natural gas-heating building in 99 percent of scenarios. A sensitivity analysis shows that the most influential factor in this decision is the future presence of green premiums in the real estate market, followed by electricity prices and local carbon penalties for building owners.
abstract_zh: 在监管机构、投资者和租户的压力下，房产所有者面临着减少建筑温室气体排放的日益增大的压力，尤其是在大城市。房地产脱碳需要房产所有者进行高昂的投资，而这些投资通常要在数十年的时间跨度内通过物业现金流的增加来收回。由于监管环境和市场状况的持续变化，对此类投资回报的评估面临挑战，这使房产所有者难以预测脱碳投资对未来能源成本、碳排放罚款或租金溢价的最终影响。在此背景下，建筑开发商需要一种工具，以评估在未来不确定性下脱碳改造的价值。这样一种用于建筑电气化的决策工具，对于新建建筑和既有建筑都至关重要。本文构建了一个综合框架，将能源建模与投资分析相结合，以支持在不确定性条件下采用脱碳技术。该综合框架包括：在广泛的能源市场和监管环境潜在路径下，以及利用蒙特卡洛模拟得出的当地绿色建筑房地产市场需求下，对技术采用所带来的成本与收益（即租金现金流、空置率、维护和能源成本的变化）的预测。此外，本文还提出了一种方法，用以考察建筑电气化设计中灵活性的潜在价值（即能够在以后年份将燃气供暖系统完全电气化的能力）。我们以纽约市一栋新建办公楼为案例说明该方法的应用。我们以天然气供暖系统作为基准，评估采用全电供暖系统的决策。我们考虑了10,000种情景，变化的因素包括未来温室气体排放罚款、对当地电网的投资、当地房地产市场状况以及能源价格。模拟结果表明，在约76%的情景下，对建筑业主而言最有利可图的决策是采用天然气供暖系统。然而，在99%的情景下，采用能够在以后日期实现完全电气化的建筑设计，比采用天然气供暖的建筑更为有利可图。敏感性分析表明，影响该决策的最主要因素是未来房地产市场中是否存在绿色溢价，其次是电价和对建筑业主的当地碳排放罚款。

title: Exploring how socioeconomic status affects neighbourhood environments' effects on obesity risks: A longitudinal study in Singapore
abstract: Research on how socioeconomic status interacts with neighbourhood characteristics to influence disparities in obesity outcomes is currently limited by residential segregation-induced structural confounding, a lack of empirical studies outside the U.S. and other ‘Western’ contexts, and an over-reliance on cross-sectional analyses. This study addresses these challenges by examining how socioeconomic status modifies the effect of accumulated exposures to obesogenic neighbourhood environments on children and mothers’ BMI, drawing from a longitudinal mother-child birth cohort study in Singapore, an Asian city-state with relatively little residential segregation. We find that increased access to park connectors was associated with a decrease in BMI outcomes for mothers with higher socioeconomic status, but an increase for those with lower socioeconomic status. We also find that increased access to bus stops was associated with an increase in BMIz of children with lower socioeconomic status, but with a decrease in BMIz of children with higher socioeconomic status, while increased access to rail stations was associated with a decrease in BMIz of children with lower socioeconomic status only. Our results suggest that urban interventions might have heterogeneous effects by socioeconomic status.
abstract_zh: 目前关于社会经济地位如何与邻里特征相互作用、从而影响肥胖结果差异的研究，受到以下限制：居住隔离引起的结构性混杂、缺乏在美国及其他“西方”语境之外的实证研究，以及过度依赖横截面分析。本研究通过考察社会经济地位如何调节累积暴露于致肥邻里环境对儿童及母亲BMI的影响，应对了这些挑战。研究数据来自新加坡的一项母婴出生纵向队列研究，新加坡是一个居住隔离程度相对较低的亚洲城市国家。我们发现，对于社会经济地位较高的母亲，更多地接近公园连接道与其BMI结果降低相关，而对于社会经济地位较低的母亲，则与其BMI升高相关。我们还发现，公交车站可达性的提高与社会经济地位较低儿童的BMIz升高相关，却与社会经济地位较高儿童的BMIz降低相关；而铁路站可达性的提高仅与社会经济地位较低儿童的BMIz降低相关。我们的结果表明，城市干预措施的效果可能因社会经济地位而异。

title: Exposures to multiple air pollutants while commuting: Evidence from Zhengzhou, China
Ghost cities versus boom towns: Do China's high speed rail new towns thrive?
Health perception and commuting choice: a survey experiment measuring behavioral trade-offs between physical activity benefits and pollution exposure risks
abstract: Previous literature suggests that active commuting has substantial health benefits. Yet, in polluted regions, it can also cause additional health risks by increasing riders’ pollution exposure and raising their inhalation rate. We examine the effect of perceived air pollution on stated commuting choices using an on-site survey experiment for 2285 non-automobile commuters in Zhengzhou, a heavily polluted city in central China. We integrate a sequential randomized controlled trial in a survey where individuals in the treatment group received tailored information on their commuting-related pollution exposure, based on our 2 week peak-hour pollution monitoring campaign across transportation modes in the city. We find that travelers in Zhengzhou have already adopted pollution prevention actions by favoring indoor commuting modes on polluted days. Individuals receiving personalized pollution exposure information by mode further decrease active commuting by 8.4 percentage points (95% CI: 5.1, 11.6), accompanied by a 14.7 percentage points (95% CI: 10.7, 18.3) increase in automobile commuting. Travellers make sub-optimal, overly risk averse choices by reducing active commuting even for trips where epidemiological research suggests the exercise benefits outweigh pollution exposure risks. This pollution avoidance tendency significantly attenuates the effect of policies encouraging active commuting. Our findings show the intricately intertwined relationships between the public health targets of promoting active lifestyles and reducing pollution exposure, and between individual pollution avoidance and societal pollution mitigation.
abstract_zh: 已有文献表明，主动通勤具有显著的健康益处。然而，在污染严重的地区，主动通勤也可能因增加骑行者的污染暴露和吸入量而带来额外的健康风险。我们在中国中部重度污染城市郑州，针对2285名非机动车通勤者开展了现场调查实验，以考察感知到的空气污染对其所陈述的通勤选择的影响。我们在调查中嵌入了一项序贯随机对照试验：处理组个体会根据我们在全市范围内、针对各交通方式开展的为期两周的高峰时段污染监测活动，获得与其通勤相关的污染暴露的个性化信息。我们发现，郑州的出行者已经在污染日采取了污染防护行动，倾向于选择室内通勤方式。接受按出行方式提供的个性化污染暴露信息的个体，主动通勤比例进一步下降8.4个百分点（95%置信区间：5.1，11.6），同时汽车通勤比例上升14.7个百分点（95%置信区间：10.7，18.3）。即使在流行病学研究表明运动益处超过污染暴露风险的出行中，出行者也会减少主动通勤，这表明他们做出了次优的、过度风险规避的选择。这种规避污染的倾向显著削弱了鼓励主动通勤政策的效果。我们的发现表明，促进积极生活方式与减少污染暴露这两项公共健康目标之间，以及个人规避污染与社会减污之间，存在错综复杂的相互关联。

abstract: Understanding how the impacts of climate change are likely to modify individual well-being in the future is crucial for developing mitigation and adaptation strategies. Despite its importance, little is known about the day-to-day impacts of weather on individual subjective well-being in developing nations. To fill this gap, we use over 400 million geotagged posts across 43 million users from the social media Weibo in China, coupled with the meteorological conditions people face when posting, to estimate how climatic factors influence people's real-time expressed sentiment. We find that extreme weather worsens emotional expressions on social media. Females and individuals in poorer cities are more responsive to unpleasant temperatures. The centralized winter heating in North China effectively increases individuals' resilience against cold temperatures, whereas measures of air-conditioning prevalence do not show a substantial adaptation effect in summer. Our projections indicate the potentially harmful impacts of global warming on future subjective well-being.
abstract_zh: 理解气候变化的影响未来可能如何改变个人福祉，对于制定减缓和适应战略至关重要。尽管其重要性不言而喻，但对于发展中国家天气对个人主观福祉的日常影响，我们所知甚少。为填补这一空白，我们利用中国社交媒体微博上4300万用户发布的逾4亿条带有地理标签的帖子，并结合人们发帖时所处的气象条件，估计气候因素如何影响人们实时表达的情绪。我们发现，极端天气会使社交媒体上的情绪表达变差。女性以及较贫困城市的居民对不适宜的气温反应更为敏感。华北地区的集中供暖有效提高了居民抵御寒冷的能力，而在夏季，空调普及程度的衡量指标并未显示出显著的适应效果。我们的预测表明，全球变暖可能对未来的主观福祉产生有害影响。

abstract: The rapid urbanization of the People’s Republic of China (PRC) is assumed to generate greater economic benefits in terms of income, but also result in greater social costs in terms of negative externalities. This chapter focuses on the direct relationship between city growth and the urban diseases of congestion and pollution in the PRC. The ‘demand–supply–government’ framework is employed to analyse the sources and consequences of these major urban diseases. The roles of market power and political power in congestion and pollution mitigation are also discussed in this chapter.
abstract_zh: 人们通常认为，中华人民共和国快速的城市化在收入方面带来了更大的经济效益，但也因负外部性而带来了更大的社会成本。本章关注中国城市增长与城市拥堵和污染这两种城市病之间的直接关系。本章采用“需求—供给—政府”框架，分析这些主要城市病的来源与后果。本章还讨论了市场势力和政治权力在缓解拥堵和污染中的作用。

abstract: Understanding the complex impact of air pollution is crucial to assessing exposure risk and defining public health policies in China. However, the evidence and hence knowledge of how urban activity responds to air pollution are limited. In this paper, we propose to use geotagged check-in records on Weibo, a Tweeter-like platform, to systematically investigate the effect of air pollution on urban activity. Based on panel models, we found clear evidence that such effect exists and varies between pollutants, visitors and residents, and different activity types. Typically, SO 2 has the largest impact, followed by PM 2.5 , NO 2 , and PM 10 ; local citizens' activities are more susceptible than visitors; leisure-related activity has a sensitivity at least twofold higher than work-related activities. Additionally, we tested hypotheses about the heterogeneous effect. We confirmed the role of Income and air quality , showing that people who live in richer and more polluted cities are more likely to experience the effects of air pollution. Specifically, people who live in a more polluted city with 100 unit increments in AvgAQI show on average the same sensitivity as those who live in a less polluted city and earn about 20.3 thousand yuan more in average Income . This reveals new insights about environmental injustice in China. By presenting a portrait of the spatial heterogeneity, we argued that environmental injustice in terms of air pollution is not just about the difference in exposure risk measured based on population distribution, rather the measurement should also consider the disparity derived from urban activity. Secondly, new injustice may arise in underdeveloped areas where manufacture industry is transferred to but people barely take avoidance behavior . Finally, the map also reveals the general neglect of the detrimental effect of light air pollution, which we speculate is partly due to China's comparatively low standard in governmental regulations. We believe our finding contributes significantly to exposure risk assessment and environmental justice debates. Hence it highlights the necessity and urgency of public healthy polices that spread the health consequence of air pollution, especially in the underdeveloped region.
abstract_zh: 理解空气污染的复杂影响，对于评估中国的暴露风险和制定公共卫生政策至关重要。然而，关于城市活动如何响应空气污染的证据与相关知识都很有限。本文提出利用类似Twitter的平台微博上带有地理标签的签到记录，系统考察空气污染对城市活动的影响。基于面板模型，我们发现明确的证据表明这种效应确实存在，并且因污染物、外来访客与常住居民以及不同活动类型而有所不同。一般而言，二氧化硫（SO2）的影响最大，其次是PM2.5、二氧化氮（NO2）和PM10；本地市民的活动比访客更易受影响；休闲相关活动的敏感性至少是工作相关活动的两倍。此外，我们还检验了关于异质性效应的假说。我们证实了收入与空气质量的作用：生活在更富裕、污染更严重城市的人，更有可能感受到空气污染的影响。具体而言，所居城市平均空气质量指数（AvgAQI）每增加100个单位、污染更严重的居民，其敏感性平均与生活在污染较轻但平均收入高出约2.03万元的城市居民相当。这为理解中国的环境不公提供了新的视角。通过描绘空间异质性的图景，我们认为，空气污染方面的环境不公不仅涉及基于人口分布测算的暴露风险差异，衡量方式还应考虑由城市活动所导致的差距。其次，在承接制造业转移但人们几乎不采取回避行为的欠发达地区，可能产生新的不公。最后，该地图还揭示出人们普遍忽视轻度空气污染的有害影响，我们推测这部分是由于中国政府监管标准相对较低所致。我们相信，这一发现对暴露风险评估和环境正义的讨论具有重要贡献。因此，本研究凸显了推行公共卫生政策、传播空气污染健康后果的必要性和紧迫性，尤其是在欠发达地区。

abstract: Over the last 30 years, China's economy has boomed. This trend has lifted hundreds of millions of Chinese out of poverty but it has also sharply increased local, regional, and global pollution levels. We look at the rise in air pollution over recent decades, and the perhaps surprising finding that in many of China's urban areas, levels of particulates (of less than 10 microns) have been decreasing during the last 10 to 15 years. We then turn to the costs and tradeoffs of air pollution, including costs to human health, reductions in worker productivity, and how people are seeking to reduce their exposure to pollution as shown by compensating differentials in real estate prices and purchases of masks and air filters. We discuss how rising incomes tend to raise the demand for environmental amenities and thus increase political pressure for environmental protection, and then we turn to the policy tools that China has used to reduce pollution. We conclude by arguing that as China's government is preparing for an additional 300 million people to move to urban areas over the next 30 years, it will have a number of opportunities for China to reduce pollution through a shift from manufacturing to services, along with various steps to improve energy efficiency and resource conservation. Overall, it seems that China is on track to improve its environmental performance in the years ahead.
abstract_zh: 过去30年间，中国经济蓬勃发展。这一趋势使数亿中国人摆脱了贫困，但也使地方、区域和全球的污染水平急剧上升。我们考察了近几十年空气污染的上升，并发现一个或许出人意料的结论：在中国的许多城市地区，粒径小于10微米的颗粒物水平在过去10至15年间一直在下降。随后，我们讨论了空气污染的成本与权衡，包括对人体健康的危害、对劳动生产率的削减，以及人们如何设法减少污染暴露，这体现在房地产价格中的补偿性差异以及口罩和空气过滤器的购买上。我们讨论了收入上升如何往往提高对环境舒适性的需求，从而增加环境保护的政治压力，随后考察了中国为减少污染所采用的政策工具。最后，我们认为，随着中国政府准备在未来30年内迎接另外3亿人口迁入城市，中国将有若干机会通过从制造业向服务业转型，以及采取各种提高能源效率和资源节约的措施来减少污染。总体而言，中国似乎正步入在未来几年改善环境表现的正确轨道。

abstract: 85% of China's GHG emissions are attributed to urban economic activities, and this share is expected to rise given China's fast urbanization process. This paper provides estimates of city‐level industrial CO2 emissions and their growth rates for all 287 Chinese prefecture‐level and above cities during the years 1998–2009. We decompose the CO2 emission changes into scale, composition and technique effects. The decomposition results show that these three effects differ significantly across the three tiers of cities in China. The scale effect contributes to rising CO2 emissions, while the technique effect leads to declining CO2 emissions in all cities. The composition effect leads to increasing CO2 emissions in the third‐tier cities, while it reduces CO2 emissions in the first and second‐tier cities, due to the relocation of energy‐intensive industries from the latter to the former type of cities. Based on these decomposition results, we identify the separate channels through which the inflow of FDI and the environmental regulations affect city‐level CO2 emissions. The decomposition framework in our paper can help policy makers and scholars to better understand Chinese cities’ trade‐offs between economic growth and environmental goals.
abstract_zh: 中国温室气体排放的85%归因于城市经济活动，鉴于中国快速的城市化进程，这一比例预计还将上升。本文估计了1998年至2009年间中国全部287个地级及以上城市的城市层面工业二氧化碳排放量及其增长率。我们将二氧化碳排放变化分解为规模效应、结构效应和技术效应。分解结果表明，这三种效应在中国三个层级的城市之间存在显著差异。规模效应促使二氧化碳排放上升，而技术效应使所有城市的二氧化碳排放下降。结构效应在三线城市中导致二氧化碳排放增加，而在一线和二线城市中则使其减少，原因在于能源密集型产业从后者向前者转移。基于这些分解结果，我们识别了外商直接投资（FDI）流入和环境规制影响城市层面二氧化碳排放的各自渠道。本文的分解框架有助于政策制定者和学者更好地理解中国城市在经济增长与环境目标之间的权衡。

abstract: China's rapid economic growth has been fueled by industrialization and urbanization. Given its export focus, this industrialization was spatially concentrated in the coastal eastern cities. Over the last decade, a spatial transformation has taken place leading to a deindustrialization of the rich coastal cities and sharp industrial growth in the inland cities. This survey examines recent work that studies the economic geography of industrial production, per-capita income, pollution and quality of life in China's cities. We focus on the interaction between firms, local governments and the central government that together determine the new economic geography of industry and pollution within China.
abstract_zh: 中国的快速经济增长以工业化和城市化为动力。由于以出口为导向，这一工业化在空间上集中于东部沿海城市。在过去十年中，发生了空间上的转型，导致富裕沿海城市去工业化，而内陆城市工业则迅速增长。本综述考察了近期关于中国城市工业生产、人均收入、污染与生活质量的经济地理学研究。我们关注企业、地方政府与中央政府之间的相互作用，正是这些相互作用共同决定了中国工业与污染的新经济地理格局。

abstract: China's ongoing urban economic growth has sharply increased the population's per capita income, lowered the count of people living below the poverty line, and caused major environmental problems. We survey the growing literature investigating the causes and consequences of China's urban pollution challenges. We begin by studying how urban population and industrial growth impacts local pollution levels and greenhouse gas production. As the urban population grows richer, its demand for private transportation and electricity sharply increases. Such privately beneficial activity exacerbates urban pollution externalities. Facing these severe environmental challenges, China's urbanites increasingly demand quality of life progress. We survey the emerging literature investigating the demand for environmental progress in China. Progress in mitigating externalities hinges on whether the powerful central and local governments choose to address these issues. We analyze the political economy of whether government officials have strong incentives to tackle lingering urban externalities. We conclude by discussing future research opportunities at the intersection of environmental and urban economics. (JEL O18, P25, P28, Q53, R23, R41, R58)
abstract_zh: 中国持续的城市经济增长大幅提高了人均收入，减少了生活在贫困线以下的人口，但也带来了重大的环境问题。我们综述了日益增多的、考察中国城市污染挑战的成因与后果的文献。我们首先研究城市人口和工业增长如何影响地方污染水平与温室气体排放。随着城市人口日益富裕，其对私家交通和电力的需求急剧增加。这种对私人有利的活动加剧了城市污染的外部性。面对这些严峻的环境挑战，中国城市居民对生活质量改善的需求日益增长。我们综述了新近出现的、考察中国环境改善需求的文献。减缓外部性的进展取决于强大的中央和地方政府是否选择应对这些问题。我们分析了政府官员是否有强烈动机去解决长期存在的城市外部性问题的政治经济学。最后，我们讨论了环境经济学与城市经济学交叉领域未来的研究机会。（JEL O18, P25, P28, Q53, R23, R41, R58）

abstract: China urbanization is associated with both increases in per-capita income and greenhouse gas emissions. This paper uses micro data to rank 74 major Chinese cities with respect to their household carbon footprint. We find that the "greenest" cities based on this criterion are Huaian and Suqian while the "dirtiest" cities are Daqing and Mudanjiang. Even in the dirtiest city (Daqing), a standardized household produces only one-fifth of that in America's greenest city (San Diego).We find that the average January temperature is strongly negatively correlated with a city's household carbon footprint, which suggests that current regional economic development policies that bolster the growth of China's northeastern cities are likely to increase emissions. We use our city specific income elasticity estimates to predict the growth of carbon emissions in China's cities.
abstract_zh: 中国的城市化既伴随着人均收入的增长，也伴随着温室气体排放的增加。本文利用微观数据，对中国74个主要城市的家庭碳足迹进行了排名。我们发现，按此标准最“绿色”的城市是淮安和宿迁，而最“高碳”的城市是大庆和牡丹江。即使在最“高碳”的城市（大庆），一个标准化家庭的排放量也仅为美国最“绿色”城市（圣地亚哥）的五分之一。我们发现，1月平均气温与城市家庭碳足迹呈强烈的负相关，这表明当前为增强中国东北城市增长而实施的区域经济发展政策，很可能会增加排放。我们利用各城市特定的收入弹性估计值来预测中国城市碳排放的增长。
